slots.workflow-matrix/title: Fragmented case ownership makes service friction hard to see and govern
slots.workflow-matrix/matrix-takeaway/text: Targets follow an agreed baseline; the measures above are candidate definitions, not claimed benefits.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-0: Teams re-enter customer and case details across channels. Incomplete requests create clarification loops and inconsistent handoffs. Four teams exchange status updates in spreadsheets.

Capture required information once, validate it at entry and route exceptions to a named owner. Retain human review where judgment or policy requires it. A synthetic baseline sample suggests 22% of cases need a manual handoff.
The sample suggests 14% arrive without enough information for first-pass processing.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-1: Specialists gather documents and reference data from multiple systems. The evidence trail depends on local files and individual knowledge. All volumes and baseline observations are synthetic assumptions.

Assemble a traceable case record through managed interfaces. Show source provenance, missing evidence and reconciliation status before the case advances. Do not present 22% or 14% as validated performance facts or a business case.
Preparation time; missing evidence; duplicate records; reconciliation exceptions
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-2: Work queues hide dependency and approval status. Escalations rely on messages, and the rationale for decisions can be difficult to recover.
Make state, ownership and approval rules explicit. Route exceptions by reason, capture decision rationale and retain an auditable record of human approvals.
Replacing the portal alone leaves manual exceptions, duplicate case state, and difficult audit reconstruction.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-3: Downstream changes require coordinated manual updates. Failures emerge through user reports, and teams reconcile outcomes after the event.
Publish validated events and managed APIs. Monitor end-to-end completion, expose failed handoffs and provide controlled retry, rollback and recovery procedures.
Cases enter through a portal, a shared operations queue, and three downstream processing systems.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-4: Reporting is assembled retrospectively. Product, service and business owners use different measures to prioritize fixes and investment. The fictional organization handles 18,000 service cases each month.
Create a shared measurement cadence with agreed definitions and owners. Use observed outcomes to prioritize the backlog, assess controls and select the next wave.
Discovery must confirm definitions, sample coverage, and ownership before business-case use.
slots.slide/takeaway: Distributed status ownership creates handoffs and weak audit reconstruction across one service journey.
